title: What does a fat cylinder look like from the side and from above?
description: A cylinder with a radius of seven centimetres and a height of fourteen centimetres is pictured before it is drawn. The video finds the profile it shows from the side and from directly above. Keeko's doubt is that the side profile is seven by fourteen.
teaching_notes: One idea: the width of the side profile is the diameter, so a cylinder whose diameter equals its height shows a square from the side. Watch for students who use the radius as the width.

source: A cylinder has radius 7 cm and height 14 cm. Picture it befo
video_script.why: The child pictures a solid in the imagination, as the book asks, and finds its two profiles with their measures.
video_script.substitution: Picture the cylinder from the side to find the width and the height, then picture it from directly above.
video_script.anchor: a cylinder with radius seven centimetres and height fourteen centimetres, pictured in the imagination
video_script.wrong_answer: the side profile is seven by fourteen
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks the side profile is a rectangle of seven by fourteen, because the radius is seven centimetres. The width goes right across the cylinder, so it is the diameter, and the profile is a square.
video_script.payoff_line: A square of side fourteen centimetres from the side, and a circle of radius seven centimetres from above

final_answer.value: A square of side 14 cm from the side and a circle of radius 7 cm from above
final_answer.spoken: a square of side fourteen centimetres from the side and a circle of radius seven centimetres from above

hold_back: Answer: A square of side 14 cm from the side and a circle of radius 7 cm from above
never_show: a rectangle 7 cm by 14 cm marked as right
maths_rules: from the side you see the width and the height
the width is the diameter: 2 x 7 = 14 cm
the height is 14 cm, equal to the width, so the side profile is a square of side 14 cm
from directly above you see the round top: a circle of radius 7 cm
slip: the width is not the radius 7 cm

<bookmark mark='height'/>The height is fourteen centimetres too.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the side profile is seven by fourteen, because the radius is seven centimetres.
<bookmark mark='top'/>Look at the round top from above. The radius goes only from the centre to the edge, so it is half of the width.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>The whole width is fourteen centimetres, so the profile is a square.
